en.title: Photopea Guide: Free Online PSD Editor — Formats, Pricing & Alternatives | ToolFavor
en.description: Photopea edits PSD files in your browser for free. See supported formats, what Premium adds, who it suits, and how it compares with Photoshop, GIMP and Canva.
en.lead: A free Photoshop-style editor that runs in your browser.
en.sublead: Open, edit and save layered PSD files, then export PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF — without installing desktop software. Files are processed on your own device.
en.snapshot: Editorial summary based on Photopea's official documentation · not a hands-on rating
en.media_alt: Photopea editor interface with layers panel and toolbar

capabilities.title: Open and save PSD
capabilities.text: PSD is Photopea's main format. Files you open are converted to PSD, so layers stay editable.

capabilities.title: Layers, masks and more
capabilities.text: Documented features include masks, layer styles, smart objects, vector shapes, text, actions and scripts.

capabilities.title: Export common formats
capabilities.text: Use File → Export As for PNG, JPG, SVG and PDF; Save for Web lets you pick format and resolution.

facts.label: Runs on
facts.value: Any modern web browser; can also be installed as a browser app

facts.label: Opens
facts.value: PSD, PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, SVG, PDF, camera RAW and about 40 other formats

facts.label: Exports
facts.value: PSD, PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF and more

facts.label: Pricing
facts.value: Free with ads; paid Premium (check the official account page for current price)

facts.label: Account
facts.value: Not needed to edit; optional login syncs your preferences

facts.label: Your files
facts.value: Processed on your device, not uploaded to Photopea's servers

good: You need to open or tweak a PSD without owning Photoshop
You're on a shared, school or work computer where you can't install software
You want layers and masks, not just one-tap filters
You'd rather your images stay on your own device
consider: You rely on Photoshop-only plugins or a full Adobe workflow
You need team collaboration and shared asset libraries
You only want quick template graphics — a template tool is faster
Ads take up 5–15% of the screen on the free version

steps.title: Go to photopea.com
steps.text: The editor loads in your browser. No sign-up form.

steps.title: Open your file
steps.text: Use File → Open, or drag a PSD, PNG or JPG into the window.

steps.title: Keep layers or export
steps.text: Save as PSD to keep editing later; export PNG or JPG to share.

compare.note: Compares positioning only — not a hands-on ranking, and features are not equivalent. Check each official site for current pricing:

alternatives.gimp: Want a free editor that works fully offline? GIMP is open-source desktop software.
alternatives.canva: Making social posts or slides? Templates get you there faster than layers.
alternatives.photoroom: Only need to remove backgrounds or make product shots? A dedicated AI tool is quicker.
alternatives.inkscape: Working mainly with SVG and vector illustration? Inkscape is built for that.
alternatives.squoosh: Just compressing or resizing images? Squoosh does it in one step in the browser.

faq.a: Yes. Photopea is free to use and is funded mainly by ads. Premium is an optional paid account; it includes a monthly allowance of AI credits. Check the official account page for the current price.

faq.q: Can Photopea open and save PSD files?
faq.a: Yes. PSD is Photopea's main format and you can save back to PSD with layers intact. For very complex files, check the result before relying on it.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No. It runs in the browser. You can optionally install it as a browser app from the More menu, but it still runs inside your browser.

Photopea states that files you open are processed on your device and are not sent to its servers. If you connect cloud storage such as Google Drive, files travel between that service and your browser.
Yes — Photopea documents AI features such as background removal and Magic Replace. Premium includes a monthly AI credit allowance.

compare.note: 製品の位置づけを比べた表で、実機テストによるランキングではありません。機能も同等ではありません。最新の料金は各公式サイトでご確認ください：

alternatives.gimp: 完全にオフラインで使える無料ソフトがいいなら、オープンソースのGIMP。
alternatives.canva: SNS画像やスライド作りが目的なら、テンプレートの方が早く仕上がります。
alternatives.photoroom: 背景を消したい・商品画像を作りたいだけなら、AI専用ツールが手軽です。
alternatives.inkscape: SVGやベクターイラストが中心なら、それに特化したInkscape。

faq.a: はい。Photopeaは主に広告収入で運営されており、無料で使えます。有料のPremiumには毎月のAIクレジットが含まれます。最新価格は公式アカウントページをご確認ください。

faq.q: PSDファイルを開いて保存できますか？
faq.a: はい。PSDはPhotopeaのメイン形式で、レイヤーを保ったままPSDで保存できます。複雑なファイルは、仕上がりを確認してから使うのがおすすめです。

faq.q: インストールは必要ですか？
faq.a: 不要です。ブラウザーで動きます。「More」メニューからブラウザーアプリとしてインストールもできますが、動作はブラウザー内です。

faq.q: 画像はアップロードされますか？安全ですか？
faq.a: Photopeaは、開いたファイルは端末内で処理され、サーバーには送られないと説明しています。Google Driveなどのクラウドを連携した場合は、そのサービスとブラウザー間でファイルがやり取りされます。
はい。背景削除やMagic ReplaceなどのAI機能が公式に紹介されています。Premiumには毎月のAIクレジットが含まれます。

compare.note: 此表只比较产品定位，不是实测排名，也不表示功能完全等价。其他产品的最新价格请查看各自官网：

alternatives.gimp: 想要完全离线、免费的编辑器？GIMP 是开源桌面软件。
alternatives.canva: 做社媒图或演示文稿？用模板比一层层处理更快。
alternatives.photoroom: 只需要抠图或做商品图？专门的 AI 工具更省事。
alternatives.inkscape: 主要处理 SVG 和矢量插画？Inkscape 专门为此设计。
alternatives.squoosh: 只是压缩或调整图片尺寸？Squoosh 在浏览器里一步完成。

faq.a: 可以。Photopea 主要依靠广告收入，可以免费使用。付费的 Premium 账户包含每月 AI 额度，具体价格请以官方账户页为准。

faq.q: Photopea 能打开并保存 PSD 文件吗？
faq.a: 可以。PSD 是 Photopea 的主要格式，可以保留图层另存为 PSD。非常复杂的设计文件建议先检查效果。
不需要，直接在浏览器中运行。也可以通过「More」菜单安装为浏览器应用，但它仍在浏览器内运行。

faq.q: Photopea 会把我的图片上传到服务器吗？
faq.a: Photopea 官方说明，打开的文件在你的设备上处理，不会发送到其服务器。如果连接 Google Drive 等云存储，文件会在该服务与浏览器之间传输。

faq.q: Photopea 有 AI 功能吗？
faq.a: 有。官方介绍了背景移除、Magic Replace 等 AI 功能，Premium 账户包含每月 AI 额度。
